acquisition_method.evidence: Peptides were selected for fragmentation automatically by data-dependent analysis.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Reduced disulfide bridges were alkylated by adding 8 μl of 20mM iodoacetamide and incubating at RT in the dark for 30 min.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Reduced disulfide bridges were alkylated by adding 8 μl of 20mM iodoacetamide and incubating at RT in the dark for 30 min.

cleavage_agent.evidence: After washing, 2 μg of trypsin (Promega) diluted in 25 μl TEAB (pH 8) was added to the S-Trap and columns were incubated at 47 °C for 1 h.

labeling.evidence: inferred: Label-free quantification (LFQ) was activated to quantify protein abundance across samples.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: analysed using an UltiMate 3000 RSLC (Dionex Corporation) coupled to a Q Exactive HF Orbitrap (Thermo Fisher Scientific) mass spectrometer.

ptm.evidence: Oxidation of methionine and N-terminal acetylations were set as variable modifications, while carbamidomethylation of cysteine was set as a fixed modification allowing a maximum of five modifications per peptide.
